description: Florida is often celebrated as a state where businesses can grow quickly and construction never seems to stop. But behind the cranes, trucks, landscaping crews and construction sites is a less visible reality: Florida workers continue to die on the job at a rate that deserves considerably more attention.In 2024, 284 Florida workers died from workplace injuries, according to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS). That was down from 306 deaths in 2023, but it still means that, on average, more
title: Florida’s Workplace Death Problem: The Workers Who Don’t Come Home
